text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Paging alex (oncall). GPU queue growing in us-west2, multiple spot interrupts. Unexpected autoscaler errors.

alex: on it, joining bridge. seeing alerts about queue length and lambda of 5k jobs. what's the current impact?

marta: customer SLOs showing tail latencies spiking to ~6s for synth traffic. A few customers reporting timeouts.

sam: autoscaler-bot just posted: `scale_event failed: quota_exceeded` for group gpu-spot-pool-usw2. stacktrace pasted.

alex: quota_exceeded... are we hitting cloud GPU regional quota or project-wide?

jin: looks like project GPU quota is at limit (requested 48, quota 48). Multiple spot VMs preempted in last 10m, backfill didn't spin up.

marta: preempt count: 12 within 7m, pool dropped from 60 -> 36. Pending queue went from 200 -> 3500.

alex: ok - immediate mitigation: 1) throttle non-critical jobs, 2) failover route for high-priority customers to dedicated pool in us-west2 (if available), 3) escalate quota or launch on-demand GPUs in us-west2 as fallback.

sam: running quick patch to route `priority=high` to dedicated-pool-usw2. command: `rbctl route set --selector priority=high --pool dedicated-pool-usw2`

online: deploy-bot: Route change applied (rev 54a9).

infra-eng: dedicated pool has spare 8 GPUs but will saturate if we shift all high-priority traffic. Also dedicated uses different model variant (fp16) - quality delta possible.

customer-sre: flagging customers with AO-7002 (high-latency). I'm drafting comms. Which tenants will be routed?

alex: target tenants list: corp-analytics, search-sync-prod, billing-worker. Sam, add exclusion for low-pri background jobs.

sam: done. background jobs now throttled via rate limiter: `rlimit set job.background 0.25`

autoscaler-bot: Autoscaler attempted scale to +16 GPUs but API returned 400: `insufficient_available_gpus` from cloud provider.

jin: that matches provider-side shortage. We tried spot, provider says no capacity in zone. We need cross-zone fallback.

alex: cross-zone fallback plan: spawn on-demand in us-west1 and us-central1 as temporary. Check network egress and latency.

marta: customer impact: visible for ~12% of requests (time>3s). Incident severity: P1 for SLO.

sam: provisioning on-demand now: `cloud-cli compute instances create --gpu nvidia-a100 --count 12 --region us-west1 --type ondemand`

infra-eng: creating, but it will take ~6-8m to boot + pull models. Meanwhile queue is still increasing.

oncall-bot: Reminder: please add runbook tag #runbook-gpu-exhaustion and attach screenshots.

alex: quick hotfix: enable KV prefix cache for embeddings route to reduce repeated warmups: `config set cache.prefix embeddings true`

jin: enabled. expecting fewer cold starts; should reduce per-request GPU time by ~20%.

marta: metrics updating — service time dropping marginally but queue still high. Need to drain backlog with extra workers.

sam: on-demand VMs are up, but model download failing on 2 instances: `403 access denied` to model-artifacts bucket. IAM policy hasn't propagated for new service accounts. Fixing ACLs.

infra-eng: patched bucket ACL to allow new instance SA. re-running pulls.

sam: pulls completed on 10 instances. routing shift in 30s.

online: deploy-bot: Routing changes to include new ondemand pool (rev 54b2).

alex: nice. Monitor queue drain rate and throttling. If backlog drops -> reduce throttle.

marta: backlog peaked at 4.1k, now 2.3k and decreasing. tail latency for critical tenants back to ~800ms.

customer-sre: sending short status update to impacted customers: brief incident note + ETA for full remediation.

autoscaler-bot: Autoscaler recovered partially — now respects cross-zone fallback flags. Logged: `fallback_to_ondemand=true`.

jin: long term: request quota increase and set autoscaler to proactively maintain a small ondemand buffer (warm ondemand replicas) to handle spot evaporation. Also consider gradual rollout of multi-zone warm pools.

alex: agreed. Create follow-up action items: 1) quota request ticket with cloud provider (inc 789204) 2) change autoscaler policy to `min_ondemand_buffer=4` 3) add runbook step for IAM propagation checks on ondemand bootstraps 4) postmortem assigned to jin/sam.

sam: adding tasks to board and assigning.

marta: closing bridge in 10m once backlog <500 and tail <500ms for 15m.

alex: great work. Final note: root cause = spot preempt storm + quota ceiling + IAM propagation friction. Consequence = temporary insufficient fallback capacity. We'll document and harden. :thumbsup:
